name: Today
job: Everything that needs you today, on one page
intro: Today gathers what every plugin in your Lemma says needs you: replies owed, choices, meetings, promises and people going quiet. Each comes with the reply, nudge or brief already prepared.
does: Leads with the few things that matter most right now.
Groups the rest by what you do: answer, decide, attend, do, or wait.
Done and Not now settle the item in the plugin it came from.
setup: Pick the time you want your day each morning.
That is all: it fills in as you add other plugins.

pictures.caption: Next up, then the day by what you do
